howItWorks.title: How RaddiBhaav Works
howItWorks.subtitle: Transparent, fast, and gives you the highest scrap price in 3 simple steps
howItWorks.step1Desc: Select categories (paper, metal, plastic, e-waste) and add approximate weights. Photos help dealers quote better.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Verified nearby kabadiwalas get notified and submit competing offers within your chosen bidding window.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Accept the highest offer. Dealer arrives with a certified digital scale, weighs in front of you, and pays directly via Cash or UPI.
